subject: Coordination: narrow-window Private/VPC demo — self-signup + SDR assist
messages:
From: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@securedata.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: Private/VPC demo — intake and narrow availability

Hi Aditya / Vivek,

We self-signed for a Private deployment demo via the form yesterday and would like to move quickly — our app processes regulated financial data and we need to validate tenant isolation, KMS integration, and audit log retention before contracting.

We have a narrow window next week for a 60-minute deep dive: Wed (26th) 14:00–17:00 CEST or Thu (27th) 13:00–16:00 CEST. Prefer an afternoon slot. Required attendees: myself (security lead), Tomasz (platform lead, will be on VPN), and our external compliance consultant (Marcin).

Could you confirm who from Redwood should attend (solutions engineering + product + sales)? Also please send a short pre-call checklist so we can run any network/allowlist steps ahead of time.

Thanks — Marie

Marie Leclerc
Security & Ops
SecureData AI
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@securedata.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Private/VPC demo — intake and narrow availability

Hi Marie — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the details.

We can absolutely do a 60-minute deep dive focused on tenant isolation, KMS, and audit logs. Proposed attendees from Redwood: me (sales/technical lead), Vivek (SDR/ops handoff), and Lauren (Solutions Engineer) — Lauren will run the technical walkthrough and answer sysadmin-level questions.

Proposed slots (CEST):
- Wed, 26 May — 14:30–15:30
- Thu, 27 May — 13:30–14:30

If either works, we’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-call checklist (network allowlist + required account details). I attached our tenant isolation checklist and a draft agenda. Can you confirm attendees + whether your compliance consultant needs a separate breakout?

Attachments: tenant_isolation_checklist.pdf, demo_agenda_v1.docx

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@securedata.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:40:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Private/VPC demo — intake and narrow availability

Looping in a quick calendar link to make booking easier — I’ve made provisional holds for both slots above. If you confirm one, I’ll convert to a firm invite and include the meeting ICS.

Also to note: we can add a short (15 min) compliance breakout immediately after the demo for deeper questions with our Compliance PM if needed.

Quick availability note: Lauren prefers Wed 14:30 CEST but can do Thu 13:30 if needed.

Vivek
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@securedata.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 17:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Private/VPC demo — intake and narrow availability

Thanks — Wed 26 May 14:30–15:30 CEST works best for us. Please include Tomasz and Marcin on the invite (CC'd here: tomasz.kowalski@securedata.ai, marcin.nowak@compliancepartners.io).

A few asks before the call so we can be prepared:
- Can you confirm the exact KV/tenant isolation doc or network ports we need to allow? (we reviewed the checklist but want a short one-page bullet list for infra team)
- We’ll need a short list of the Redwood attendees and their role for our internal calendar (so we can mark who gets elevated access during the demo).

We’ll plan for the compliance breakout after the demo.

Marie
(ops@securedata.ai)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marie Leclerc <marie.leclerc@securedata.ai>, Tomasz Kowalski <tomasz.kowalski@securedata.ai>, Marcin Nowak <marcin.nowak@compliancepartners.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Private/VPC demo — intake and narrow availability

Scheduled: Wed, 26 May — 14:30–15:30 CEST (60m) — I sent a firm calendar invite (private-demo-calendar.ics) to all attendees. Agenda and pre-call checklist are attached.

Quick responses to your asks (short bullets for infra):
- Ports & IPs: allow outbound to 18.197.45.0/24 and 52.93.120.0/24; TCP 443 only.
- KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) — we’ll need the KMS key ARN ahead of any PoC.
- Tenant isolation: see attached tenant_isolation_checklist.pdf (summary on p2).

Redwood attendees:
- Aditya Rao — Account Exec (sales/contract lead)
- Lauren Bishop — Solutions Engineer (demo lead)
- Vivek Kulkarni — SDR / Ops coord

We’ll hold a 15-minute compliance breakout after the demo with our Compliance PM (optional). If anything changes on your side, flag it here and we’ll swap slots. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Aditya

Attachments: tenant_isolation_checklist.pdf, private-demo-calendar.ics, demo_agenda_v1.docx
